notes.title: New Systems & Achievements Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557233/47b5fc47ac34331447e5cd73598919eda7100457.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Systems & Achievements Update[/b][/p][p][b]Final Update After the Comic Exhibition[/b][/p][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Adventure Mode[/b] – Learn the basics of gameplay through this mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goblin King[/b] – Challenge a slightly more difficult AI opponent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement System[/b] – Unlock achievements by completing specific challenges.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance & Optimization Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Millennium Zombie Cocoon[/b]: HP increased from 3 → 4[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Wand “Memory Unlock!”[/b]: Jellyfish can only summon up to 4[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fried Egg Jellyfish[/b]: ATK increased from 0 → 1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gunslinger Dan Yakushiji[/b]: Removed “Rebirth”; “Cover Shot” now deals +1 additional damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]BOSS Ku[/b]: Mana cost increased from 6 → 7; removed “Boss Ku Aura”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elf Shirayuki Tsuki[/b]: ATK decreased from 4 → 3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Xin Xili Can Save Lives[/b]: Mana cost increased from 2 → 3; effect changed to affect all allied units[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Preview
notes.notes: [p]With the conclusion of the event, [i]Virtual Frenzy – Nexus Corps[/i], the mission of this namesake card game has also come to an end.[/p][p]However, as the developer, I hope it will be more than just an event-exclusive game — something players can still revisit and enjoy as a single-player experience from time to time.[/p][p]To enhance its playability, the final version will include the following features:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Goblin King[/b] – In AI battles, you can challenge the Goblin King (with a unique AI deck).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adventure Mode[/b] – Offers tutorials and simple challenges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement System[/b] – Complete specific challenges to unlock Steam achievements.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Some features and card balance issues previously mentioned in player feedback will also be addressed in future updates, including cloud save support.[/p]
